title: Production-Oriented Inventory Management Platform
objective: Build a Rust backend that manages products, stock levels, inventory movements, and application users through a documented API.
skills: Modular domain model using structs, enums, traits, and validated types.
HTTP API with request validation and consistent error responses.
Database persistence, transactions, and schema migrations.
Authentication and authorization via an appropriately selected maintained library.
Tests for domain logic, API behavior, and database integration.
Structured logging, configuration, graceful shutdown, and release automation.
Performance measurements and architecture decision notes.
